content.json:
## Rootline Inventory
Read-only inventory of your Azure estate, powered by Azure Resource Graph. Pick your scope below, then switch tabs. Every grid can be filtered and exported to Excel.

<sub>v1.0.0 · open source (MIT) · [github.com/Mengokai/estate-inventory](https://github.com/Mengokai/estate-inventory) · not affiliated with Microsoft</sub>

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups'
| distinct name
| order by name asc
| project value = name, label = name

parameters.name: Location
parameters.label: Locations
parameters.query:
resources
| where isnotempty(location)
| distinct location
| order by location asc
| project value = location, label = location

parameters.name: TagName
parameters.label: Tag name
parameters.query:
resources
| where isnotempty(tags)
| mv-expand tags
| extend k = tostring(bag_keys(tags)[0])
| where isnotempty(k)
| distinct k
| order by k asc
| project value = k, label = k

parameters.name: TagValue
parameters.label: Tag value
parameters.query:
resources
| where isnotempty('{TagName}')
| extend v = tostring(tags['{TagName}'])
| where isnotempty(v)
| distinct v
| order by v asc
| project value = v, label = v

content.query:
resources
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where '*' in ({Location}) or location in~ ({Location})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or (isnotempty(tostring(tags['{TagName}'])) and (isempty('{TagValue}') or tostring(tags['{TagName}']) =~ '{TagValue}'))
| summarize Res = count(), Subs = dcount(subscriptionId), RGs = dcount(tolower(strcat(subscriptionId, '/', resourceGroup))), Types = dcount(type), Locs = dcount(location)
| extend m = pack_array(pack('Metric', 'Resources', 'Count', Res), pack('Metric', 'Subscriptions', 'Count', Subs), pack('Metric', 'Resource groups', 'Count', RGs), pack('Metric', 'Resource types', 'Count', Types), pack('Metric', 'Locations', 'Count', Locs))
| mv-expand m
| project Metric = tostring(m.Metric), Count = tolong(m.Count)
content.noDataMessage: No matching resources in the selected scope.

content.query:

| where '*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where '*' in ({Location}) or location in~ ({Location})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or (isnotempty(tostring(tags['{TagName}'])) and (isempty('{TagValue}') or tostring(tags['{TagName}']) =~ '{TagValue}'))
| where isnotempty(tags)
| mv-expand tags
| extend TagKey = tostring(bag_keys(tags)[0])
| where isnotempty(TagKey)
| extend TagValue = tostring(tags[TagKey])
| summarize Resources = count(), DistinctValues = dcount(TagValue) by TagKey
| extend j = 1
| join kind=inner (resources
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where '*' in ({Location}) or location in~ ({Location})
| where isempty('{TagName}') or (isnotempty(tostring(tags['{TagName}'])) and (isempty('{TagValue}') or tostring(tags['{TagName}']) =~ '{TagValue}'))
| summarize Total = count() | extend j = 1) on j
| project TagKey, Resources, CoveragePct = round(100.0 * Resources / Total, 1), DistinctValues
| order by Resources desc

| project Subscription = name, subscriptionId, State = tostring(properties.state), ManagementGroup = tostring(properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain[0].displayName), MgDepth = array_length(properties.managementGroupAncestorsChain), OfferType = tostring(properties.subscriptionPolicies.quotaId), Resources = coalesce(Resources, 0)
